name: BWL Suppression Aura (22247) expires after 6s and does not stack across casters (#10097)
contract: #10097 reported Suppression Aura (22247) in BWL never expiring, persisting across logout, and distorting melee attack speed when stacking. Ascension's Spell.dbc gives 22247 DurationIndex 21 (-1 ms, permanent) and SPELL_ATTR3_DOT_STACKING_RULE (0x80), while AscensionStockScriptShapes restores its three stock WotLK effects (-80% move speed, -400% melee haste = 5x attack time, -80% cast speed). Expected: 22247 has stock 6000 ms duration (DurationIndex 32), does not stack multiplicatively when cast by a second hostile caster (attack time stays 5x, not 25x), expires cleanly within 10s, and restores move speed and attack time to baseline.

steps.label: SETUP: Suppression Aura (22247) applies from first caster
DISCRIMINATING: Suppression Aura has 6000 ms finite duration instead of permanent -1
Suppression Aura reduces run speed by 80%
Single Suppression Aura increases melee attack time to 5x
DISCRIMINATING: second caster refreshes instead of stacking attack time to 25x
DISCRIMINATING: Suppression Aura expires once casts stop
Melee attack time returns to baseline after expiry
Run speed returns to baseline after expiry
